title: Huge pothole near Lanka crossing
description: There is a huge pothole near Lanka crossing in Varanasi. It has been there for weeks and two-wheelers are struggling to pass, causing traffic jams and minor slips.

title: Dangerous deep road crater at Lanka junction
description: A very deep crater has opened up right near the Lanka crossing traffic signal. Vehicles are swerving sharply to avoid damage and an accident will happen soon.

title: Broken road surface causing skidding near Lanka
description: The asphalt has completely eroded near Lanka crossing towards BHU gate. Gravel is loose and bikes are skidding every evening during rush hour.

title: Potholes making Lanka road impassable
description: Multiple potholes along Lanka road leading up to the main intersection. Two-wheelers falling down when water accumulates.

title: Massive garbage pileup near Godowlia chowk
description: Garbage has not been collected for three days near Godowlia chowk. Stray animals are scattering trash across the street and creating foul stench.

title: Overflowing waste dumpster at Godowlia market entrance
description: The community waste bin near Godowlia intersection is overflowing completely onto the pedestrian walkway. Rotten food waste attracts flies and diseases.

title: Uncollected trash blocking alley near Godowlia
description: Municipal sanitation truck has skipped our lane near Godowlia chowk. Heavy rotting waste bags piled high by shopkeepers.

title: Overflowing sewer manhole in Sigra main market
description: Black dirty sewage water is spilling from a clogged manhole near Sigra crossing. Street is submerged in filthy water and entering shopfronts.

title: Severe waterlogging due to blocked drain in Sigra
description: Drain line near Sigra crossing is choked with silt and plastic debris. Even slight rainfall causes knee-deep water stagnation for days.

title: Foul smelling gutter overflow near Sigra stadium road
description: Open gutter overflowing onto the road near Sigra. Pedestrians cannot cross without stepping into toxic wastewater.

title: Main drinking water pipeline leak at Assi Ghat
description: Clean drinking water is gushing out of a cracked municipal pipeline near Assi Ghat entrance. Thousands of liters wasted while residents face dry taps.

title: Zero water pressure in Assi residential quarters
description: No municipal water supply in taps since yesterday morning in Assi colony. Low pressure pipe cannot reach overhead tanks.

title: Brown contaminated muddy water from tap in Assi
description: Tap water supplied this morning near Assi ghat is yellowish brown with mud particles. Unfit for consumption or cooking.

title: Sparking overhead transformer near Pandeypur crossing
description: The roadside electrical transformer near Pandeypur crossing is making loud buzzing noises and sparking intermittently. Loose hanging wire poses electrocution risk.

title: Hanging high voltage wire over road near Pandeypur
description: A live electric wire has snapped from the pole and is hanging just 6 feet above the street near Pandeypur. Extremely dangerous for pedestrians.

title: All streetlights non-functional on Pandeypur bypass
description: Six consecutive street light poles are broken and dark on Pandeypur bypass road. Total darkness at night causing safety hazard.

title: Traffic signal malfunctioning at Cantt railway station
description: The automatic traffic lights at Cantt station junction are stuck on red in all directions. Severe traffic jam during morning peak hours.

title: Illegal auto-rickshaw encroachment blocking Cantt entrance
description: Autos are parked three rows deep blocking the pedestrian zebra crossing and bus bay at Cantt railway station. Pedestrians forced into traffic.

title: Broken pedestrian pavement tiles at Cantt station
description: Pavement stones and pavers are cracked and dislodged on Cantt station walkway. Wheelchair access is completely obstructed.

title: Filthy community toilet complex in Bhelupur
description: Public toilet near Bhelupur water works has no running water, broken flush valves, and extreme stench. Public is unable to use it.

title: Streetlight pole tilted dangerously in Mahmoorganj
description: Metal streetlight pole has bent towards the road after being hit by a truck near Mahmoorganj. It might collapse during high winds.

title: Continuous water leakage flooding Mahmoorganj lane
description: Underground pipe has sprung a leak opposite Mahmoorganj post office. Clean water is ponding on road and degrading asphalt.

title: Flickering street lamp outside Durgakund temple
description: The sodium streetlight in front of Durgakund temple blinks constantly throughout the night. Needs bulb and ballast replacement.

title: Damaged safety railing along Dashashwamedh ghat stairs
description: Iron railing on the main descent towards Dashashwamedh ghat has rusted through and detached. Elderly pilgrims have no support while climbing.

title: Garbage dumped by food stalls near Dashashwamedh
description: Evening food vendors dumping plates and leftover cooking oil into open street corners near Dashashwamedh. Unhygienic and attracting rodents.

title: Clogged storm drain overflowing in Orderly Bazar
description: Drain along Orderly Bazar main market is packed with plastic bottles and polythene. Sewage backing up into resident basements.

title: Broken bus stop shed shelter in Shivpur
description: The tin roof of the public bus waiting shelter at Shivpur main stop was blown off. Commuters have no shade from sun or rain.

title: Public urinal without water or drainage at Sarnath
description: Sanitation facility near Sarnath deer park entrance is clogged and overflowed with filth. Foul odor spreading across tourist walking track.

title: Low hanging power wire near Maidagin crossing
description: There is a loose electric cable hanging near Maidagin crossing. Needs immediate municipal electrician attention.

title: Unscheduled power cuts causing water shortage
description: Frequent power outages in our locality throughout afternoon. Tubewell pump cannot operate and water supply is severely affected.

title: Request for municipal garbage truck route extension
description: Our residential lane has no designated garbage collector visit. Please add lane number 4 to morning door-to-door waste collection.
